game.title: Mario Kart 8
game.estimatedHours: 15-20h for the base list, +5-8h per DLC pack
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Wii U has no native achievement system, and Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Switch) has no native list either, so no port source exists. Base list covers the vanilla Wii U base game only (8 cups / 32 tracks); both paid DLC packs get their own separate lists under `dlc` per Rule 14 and never affect the base Platinum. 200cc and Mirror Mode arrived via free post-launch updates (Ver. 4.0/4.1, April-May 2015) and are unlocked by default on any currently patched copy, so no trophy is built around 'unlocking' them — they're treated as simply two of the five available engine classes. All Nintendo Network online features (online races, VR/BR ratings, online win/loss tracking, Mario Kart TV online sharing) were permanently shut down April 8, 2024, and Miiverse (which displayed Staff Ghost stamps) shut down in November 2017 — no trophy depends on either. Amiibo-unlocked Mii Racing Suits are excluded as hardware/purchase-dependent (~19 suits requiring physical amiibo figures the player may not own). The Gold Glider vehicle part (10,000 lifetime coins, a purely cosmetic reward with no gameplay benefit) is deliberately excluded per Rule 20 — it represents excessive grinding without meaningful experiential gain, unlike the ~2,800-coin threshold for all standard parts, which is included. Battle Mode in the vanilla Wii U release is thin by design (only Balloon Battle, played on repurposed race tracks rather than dedicated arenas — the arena overhaul is exclusive to Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch) and is represented by a single trophy rather than inflated with redundant Battle Mode content. Vehicle-part and coin-threshold figures (e.g. ~2,800 coins for all standard parts, Gold Standard/Gold Tires unlock conditions) are community-sourced (GameFAQs, SuperCheats) and cross-corroborated across independent research passes, but no official Nintendo total was found — treated as medium-confidence but design-safe since all are genuine persistent, visually-verifiable in-game unlocks regardless of the exact coin count.

trophies.name: Race to First
trophies.description: Win your first race, in any mode.
trophies.verification: The end-of-race results screen shows a 1st place finish.

trophies.name: Podium Debut
trophies.description: Earn a cup trophy by completing your first Grand Prix Cup.
trophies.verification: The cup results screen awards a trophy (bronze or better) after the fourth race.

trophies.name: New Wheels
trophies.description: Unlock your first new vehicle part by collecting coins during races.
trophies.verification: A previously locked part becomes selectable in the garage customization screen.

trophies.name: Familiar Face
trophies.description: Unlock your first hidden character by winning a Grand Prix Cup.
trophies.verification: The character's portrait replaces its silhouette on the character-select screen.

trophies.name: Ghost Beater
trophies.description: Beat the Staff Ghost's time on any track in Time Trial for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Time Trial results screen shows your ghost finishing ahead of the Staff Ghost.

trophies.name: Last Balloon Standing
trophies.description: Win a round of Balloon Battle.
trophies.verification: The Battle results screen names you the winner.

trophies.name: Grand Prix Together
trophies.description: Complete a Grand Prix race in local split-screen multiplayer with a friend.
trophies.verification: The race finishes with two or more human-controlled racers sharing the screen.

trophies.name: Grand Prix Champion
trophies.description: Take 1st place in all 8 base-game cups at 150cc.
trophies.verification: All 8 cups display an earned trophy on the 150cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Through the Looking Glass
trophies.description: Clear all 8 base-game cups in Mirror Mode.
trophies.verification: All 8 cups show a completed result on the Mirror cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Fully Loaded
trophies.description: Unlock every standard vehicle part through lifetime coin collection.
trophies.verification: No locked (silhouette) parts remain in the garage customization screen, aside from the three Gold parts.

trophies.name: Full Roster
trophies.description: Unlock all 30 playable characters.
trophies.verification: No silhouettes remain on the character-select screen.

trophies.name: Into the Fast Lane
trophies.description: Complete all 8 base-game cups at 200cc for the first time.
trophies.verification: All 8 cups show a completed result on the 200cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Double Century
trophies.description: Take 1st place in all 8 base-game cups at 200cc.
trophies.verification: All 8 cups display an earned trophy on the 200cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Flawless Run
trophies.description: Earn a 3-star rank in all 8 base-game cups at 150cc.
trophies.verification: All 8 cups display 3 stars on the 150cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Golden Rubber
trophies.description: Unlock the Gold Tires by beating the Staff Ghost on every track in the base game.
trophies.verification: The Gold Tires appear as a selectable part in the garage customization screen.

trophies.name: Racing Royalty
trophies.description: Unlock the Gold Standard kart body by earning at least one star in every cup, in every engine class you play through.
trophies.verification: The Gold Standard body appears as a selectable part in the garage customization screen.

trophies.name: Grand Prix Grandmaster
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All base-game trophies show as earned.

dlc.name: The Legend of Zelda x Mario Kart 8

trophies.name: A Link to the Grand Prix
trophies.description: Race as Link for the first time.
trophies.verification: Link is selected and a race is completed with him active.

trophies.name: Cracking the Egg Cup
trophies.description: Complete the Egg Cup Grand Prix.
trophies.verification: The Egg Cup shows a completed result on the cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Piece of the Triforce Cup
trophies.description: Complete the Triforce Cup Grand Prix.
trophies.verification: The Triforce Cup shows a completed result on the cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Hylian Grand Prix
trophies.description: Take 1st place in both the Egg Cup and the Triforce Cup at 150cc.
trophies.verification: Both cups display an earned trophy on the 150cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Ocarina of Time Trial
trophies.description: Beat the Staff Ghost on Hyrule Circuit in Time Trial.
trophies.verification: The Time Trial results screen shows your ghost finishing ahead of the Staff Ghost on Hyrule Circuit.

trophies.name: Triforce of Speed
trophies.description: Take 1st place in both the Egg Cup and the Triforce Cup at 200cc.
trophies.verification: Both cups display an earned trophy on the 200cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Mayor on the Move
trophies.description: Race as Isabelle for the first time.
trophies.verification: Isabelle is selected and a race is completed with her active.

trophies.name: Ringing the Bell Cup
trophies.description: Complete the Bell Cup Grand Prix.
trophies.verification: The Bell Cup shows a completed result on the cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Changing Seasons
trophies.description: Complete the Crossing Cup Grand Prix, driving the seasonal Animal Crossing track.
trophies.verification: The Crossing Cup shows a completed result on the cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Model Villager
trophies.description: Take 1st place in both the Bell Cup and the Crossing Cup at 150cc.
trophies.verification: Both cups display an earned trophy on the 150cc cup-select screen.

trophies.name: Matching Set
trophies.description: Unlock the exclusive Yoshi and Shy Guy color variants by owning both Mario Kart 8 DLC packs.
trophies.verification: The additional Yoshi and Shy Guy color swatches appear on the character-select screen once both packs are installed.
trophies.notes: Requires owning The Legend of Zelda x Mario Kart 8 as well as this pack — not completable from this pack alone. Disclosed openly in the description; the two DLC packs were also sold as a discounted bundle.

trophies.name: Interest Paid in Full
trophies.description: Take 1st place in both the Bell Cup and the Crossing Cup at 200cc.
trophies.verification: Both cups display an earned trophy on the 200cc cup-select screen.
